title: Ahomar Din (আহোমৰ দিন - ২য় সংস্কৰণ)
author: Hiteswar Borbaruah (হিতেশ্বৰ বৰবৰুৱা)
description: The monumental 600-page historical treatise on the six-century reign of the Tai-Ahom dynasty in the Brahmaputra valley. Authored by noted historian Hiteswar Borbaruah, it provides granular archival accounts of administrative offices (Barbarua, Barphukan, Phukan, Barua), royal court rituals (Me-Dam-Me-Phi, Choklong), and diplomacy with Nora, Tai Khamti, and Tai Phake rulers across the Patkai.
source: Guwahati: Publication Board Assam, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451863
